references.title: Transcranial Direct Current Stimulation Attenuates the Chronic Pain of Osteoarthritis in Rats via Reducing NMDAR2B Expressions in the Spinal Cord.
references.note: rat MIA knee OA, spinal cord: NMDA receptor GluN2B raised in the spinal cord with the pain behaviour, reversed by tDCS

references.title: Inhibition of interleukin-6 function attenuates the central sensitization and pain behavior induced by osteoarthritis.
references.note: rat MIA knee OA, dorsal horn: NMDA subunit NR2B (and GluR1) upregulated in the ipsilateral dorsal horn with central sensitisation

references.title: Spinal pain processing in arthritis: Neuron and glia (inter)actions.
references.note: review of spinal pain processing in arthritis, osteoarthritis models included: spinal sensitisation depends on spinal glutamate receptors

references.title: Structural basis of ketamine action on human NMDA receptors.
references.note: cryo-EM of human GluN1-GluN2A and GluN1-GluN2B NMDA receptors with glutamate and glycine bound

references.title: Subunit arrangement and function in NMDA receptors.
references.note: NMDA receptor structure and function: activation needs glycine on GluN1 and glutamate on GluN2, then cations flow in

references.title: Acupotomy Alleviates Pain and Attenuates Spinal Neuronal Hyperexcitability in Knee Osteoarthritis Rats: Implication of the CaMKII/GluA1 Axis.
references.note: rat MIA knee OA, spinal substantia gelatinosa: Gria1/GluA1 and its phosphorylation raised with neuronal hyperexcitability, both lowered by the treatment

references.title: Spinal pain processing in arthritis: Neuron and glia (inter)actions.
references.note: review, arthritis including osteoarthritis models: spinal AMPA receptors carry spinal sensitisation to knee input

references.title: Expression of AMPA receptor subunits at synapses in laminae I-III of the rodent spinal dorsal horn.
references.note: rat dorsal horn laminae I-III: GluA1 and GluA3 sit together at glutamatergic synapses (but with GluA2)

references.title: Structure and organization of heteromeric AMPA-type glutamate receptors.
references.note: structures of AMPA receptor heteromers (GluA2/3, GluA2/4): GluA1-GluA4 assemble as heteromeric tetramers around a central axis

references.title: Architecture, dynamics and biogenesis of GluA3 AMPA glutamate receptors.
references.note: GluA3 cryo-EM (rat constructs, human disease mutations mapped): GluA3 forms a Ca2+-permeable, fast-transmitting receptor at sensory synapses

references.title: Acupotomy Alleviates Pain and Attenuates Spinal Neuronal Hyperexcitability in Knee Osteoarthritis Rats: Implication of the CaMKII/GluA1 Axis.
references.note: rat MIA knee OA: GluA1 (Gria1) in the spinal substantia gelatinosa drives the hyperexcitability of these neurons

references.title: Inhibition of interleukin-6 function attenuates the central sensitization and pain behavior induced by osteoarthritis.
references.note: rat MIA knee OA: GluR1 (GluA1) upregulated in the ipsilateral dorsal horn, with c-Fos and pain behaviour

references.title: Identification and functional evaluation of GRIA1 missense and truncation variants in individuals with ID: An emerging neurodevelopmental syndrome.
references.note: human GRIA1 variants from patients, GluA1-containing AMPA receptors assayed in vitro: GluA1 forms a glutamate-gated channel whose function the variants perturb

references.title: Inflammation-induced GluA1 trafficking and membrane insertion of Ca(2+) permeable AMPA receptors in dorsal horn neurons is dependent on spinal tumor necrosis factor, PI3 kinase and protein kinase A.
references.note: rat inflammation: GluA2-lacking, Ca2+-permeable GluA1 receptors are inserted into synapses of nociceptive dorsal horn projection neurons

references.title: Glutamate gating of AMPA-subtype iGluRs at physiological temperatures.
references.note: cryo-EM at physiological temperature: glutamate binding opens the AMPA receptor channel and lets cations in

references.title: Acupotomy Alleviates Pain and Attenuates Spinal Neuronal Hyperexcitability in Knee Osteoarthritis Rats: Implication of the CaMKII/GluA1 Axis.
references.note: rat MIA knee OA: spinal neurons of the substantia gelatinosa fire at abnormally high frequency, with calcium signalling genes enriched

references.title: Spinal pain processing in arthritis: Neuron and glia (inter)actions.
references.note: review, arthritis and osteoarthritis models: the spinal hyperexcitability these currents produce is the spinal side of arthritis pain

references.title: Fractional calcium currents through recombinant GluR channels of the NMDA, AMPA and kainate receptor subtypes.
references.note: recombinant receptors in HEK293: glutamate-gated current carries Ca2+ through NMDA receptors (8-11% of the current) and through GluA2(Q)-lacking AMPA receptors, almost none through GluA2(R)-containing ones; the rest is Na+

references.title: Selective Reduction of Ca(2+) Entry Through the Human NMDA Receptor: a Quantitative Study by Simultaneous Ca(2+) and Na(+) Imaging.
references.note: human NMDA receptors and human iPSC-derived neurons: simultaneous Ca2+ and Na+ imaging measures the Ca2+ share of the NMDA current

references.title: Glutamate gating of AMPA-subtype iGluRs at physiological temperatures.
references.note: AMPA receptor gating: the channel opens on glutamate binding and cations enter the postsynaptic neuron

references.title: Spinal pain processing in arthritis: Neuron and glia (inter)actions.
references.note: review, arthritis including osteoarthritis: spinal AMPA receptors are needed for spinal sensitisation to joint input (no OA paper on GluA4 itself)

references.title: Acupotomy Alleviates Pain and Attenuates Spinal Neuronal Hyperexcitability in Knee Osteoarthritis Rats: Implication of the CaMKII/GluA1 Axis.
references.note: rat MIA knee OA: AMPA receptor subunit GluA1 and spinal neuronal hyperexcitability in knee OA (GluA4 not measured)

references.title: Expression of AMPA receptor subunits at synapses in laminae I-III of the rodent spinal dorsal horn.
references.note: rat dorsal horn: the long form of GluA4 is at synapses of lamina I cells, apparently including projection neurons, but largely separate from GluA1

references.title: Structural basis for activation and conformational plasticity of the GluA4 AMPA receptor.
references.note: cryo-EM of the GluA4 receptor (rat GluA4 with human TARP gamma-2; human disease variants mapped): all four binding domains bind glutamate and open the channel, which is Ca2+ permeable

references.title: Structure and organization of heteromeric AMPA-type glutamate receptors.
references.note: AMPA receptor heteromer structures including GluA2/GluA4: GluA1-GluA4 form heteromeric tetramers
